external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Together with FIFA and Global Citizen, MetLife is helping turn the universal passion for soccer (or football, for those outside the US) into a global force for education, ensuring that every child, no matter where they live, has the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive.

Together with FIFA and Global Citizen, MetLife is helping turn the universal passion for soccer (or football, for those outside the US) into a global force for education, ensuring that every child, no matter where they live, has the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive.

The FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund aims to help change that. Financing from the Fund has been and will continue to be granted to grassroots education programs and organizations in over 200 countries worldwide, in addition to investments into community development and learning through the sport around the world, through Football For Schools (F4S), a joint FIFA and UNESCO program.
Stage is Set for New, First-Of-It-Kind Partnership Between IHC and Global Citizen

network.coverage_note: Global Citizen is an international advocacy organization rather than a traditional educational institution, so it does not have campuses or a standard Erasmus mobility program. The evidence lists various corporate and international partners but does not provide a comprehensive partner list.
